GMB.note: The document states no link between the civil register and the ID system.
No count or share of people enrolled is given; nationwide enrolment starts 4 August 2026.
No number at birth is mentioned.

facts.fact: MIDSA, a subsidiary of Ghana's Margins ID Group, was awarded the contract in January 2026 to design, deploy and operate the National Identity Management System under a Build, Operate and Transfer agreement.

systems.system: National Identity Management System (NIMS) / GAM ID

GMB.note: No public register keyed on the ID number is named; the system is said to link government agencies in general terms.

facts.fact: The Gambia launched its National Identity Management System on 30 June 2026 with instant issuance of the GAM ID, a pilot for selected institutions from 6 to 29 July and nationwide enrolment from 4 August, per the Ministry of Information.
